hunks.baseline: When someone suddenly changes, the people around them can’t help feeling uneasy.
hunks.sol: When someone changes in an instant, the people around them can’t help feeling uneasy.

hunks.baseline: “Hh…”
At Great Sir’s sudden groan, the silence shattered—and the air around us froze.
hunks.sol: Great Sir’s sudden groan broke the silence, and the air around us seemed to freeze.

hunks.baseline: Our allies had been moving quickly and quietly, keeping low among the shallow hills and reeds. Now they reflexively tightened their grips on their weapons. Jeok Cheongang was among them.
hunks.sol: We’d been moving quickly and quietly, keeping low among the shallow hills and reeds. Now everyone reflexively gripped their weapons. Jeok Cheongang was no exception.

hunks.baseline: At Jeok Cheongang’s low, grave question, everyone—including me—turned toward Great Sir.
hunks.sol: At his low question, everyone—including me—turned toward Great Sir.

hunks.baseline: His face had gone rigid without anyone noticing. His pupils, usually a little unfocused, had suddenly dilated, as if reflecting his state of mind. A bead of cold sweat rolled down his forehead.
hunks.sol: His face had gone rigid. His pupils, usually a little unfocused, had dilated, and a bead of cold sweat rolled down his forehead.

hunks.baseline: If we’d been in Gansu, I might’ve just wondered what crazy thing he was going to say this time and let it pass.
hunks.sol: If we’d been in Gansu, I might’ve wondered what crazy thing he was going to say this time and let it pass.

hunks.baseline: But no matter how unhinged he was, Great Sir was an undisputed Supreme Peak master. We were in enemy territory, with threats lurking everywhere. And though it might’ve been a coincidence, he was the first to notice the enemy using birds to spy on us. His words weren’t something we could simply brush aside.
hunks.sol: But however unhinged he was, Great Sir was an undisputed Supreme Peak master. We were in enemy territory, with threats lurking everywhere. And though it might have been a coincidence, he’d been the first to notice the enemy using birds to spy on us. We couldn’t simply brush off what he said.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang asked gravely. Great Sir nodded.
hunks.sol: Great Sir nodded at Jeok Cheongang’s grave question.

hunks.baseline: “Explain in more detail. And be polite if you don’t want to get beaten to death.”
hunks.sol: “Explain. And speak respectfully if you don’t want to get beaten to death.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang chuckled at Great Sir’s answer, then turned to me.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang gave a dry chuckle at Great Sir’s answer, then turned to me.

hunks.baseline: “I thought I’d check. Anyway, so it really isn’t all right?”
hunks.sol: “I thought I’d check. So it really isn’t all right?”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. The code of the martial world has fallen to the ground.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. What’s become of the code of the martial world?”

hunks.baseline: “Fine. I understand. Now keep talking. What exactly does this feeling feel like?”
hunks.sol: “Fine. Keep talking. What exactly does it feel like?”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know. Somehow, it feels familiar…”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know. It feels familiar somehow, but… Urgh!”

hunks.baseline: “Ulp!”
Before he could finish, Great Sir groaned again.
hunks.sol: Before he could finish, another groan burst from him.

hunks.baseline: His face went pale. He moved before anyone had a chance to stop him.
hunks.sol: Great Sir’s face went pale, and he moved before anyone could stop him.

hunks.baseline: His figure shot away so quickly it left a blur behind. Great Sir vanished among the dense reeds in an instant. Jeok Cheongang, the other Supreme Peak masters, and I hurried after him.
hunks.sol: He shot away so fast he left a blurred afterimage. As he vanished among the dense reeds, Jeok Cheongang, the other Supreme Peak masters, and I hurried after him.

hunks.baseline: Or, more precisely, we were about to.
hunks.sol: Or rather, we were about to.

hunks.baseline: Until a certain sound rang out clearly from the reeds.
hunks.sol: Then a sound rang out clearly from the reeds.

hunks.baseline: *Flap, flap-flap-flap!*
hunks.sol: *Prrt, splat-splat-splat!*

hunks.baseline: What the hell was that?
hunks.sol: What the fuck?

hunks.baseline: Just as we all began to dread the answer, Great Sir’s voice confirmed our suspicions.
hunks.sol: Just as we all began to dread the answer, Great Sir’s voice confirmed it.

hunks.baseline: “Ahhh, that’s better…”
hunks.sol: “Ahhh, that’s a relief…”

hunks.baseline: A deathly silence settled over the area. Jeok Cheongang stared at me in disbelief, then finally parted his tightly shut lips.
hunks.sol: A deathly silence fell. Jeok Cheongang stared at me in disbelief, then finally parted his tightly shut lips.

hunks.baseline: But I resisted the urge through superhuman self-control and shook my head.
hunks.sol: But with superhuman self-control, I resisted the urge and shook my head.

hunks.baseline: If he could just refrain from acting like a complete idiot for once, that’d be a miracle. What had I expected from someone who didn’t even know his own name?
hunks.sol: I’d be grateful if he could just stop acting like an idiot. What had I expected from someone who didn’t even know his own name?

hunks.baseline: I swallowed a sigh. Great Sir—who’d just finished taking care of business with a racket that was anything but discreet—emerged looking completely at ease.
hunks.sol: I swallowed a sigh. Great Shit—no, Great Sir—emerged from the reeds after finishing his remarkably noisy business, looking completely at ease.

hunks.baseline: “……A minute ago, you said you felt really bad.”
hunks.sol: “…A minute ago, you said you felt terrible.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re pissing me off.”
hunks.sol: “You’re really pissing me off.”

hunks.baseline: “Hm. That’s a bad habit. It doesn’t bother me, but you should break it soon. If you talk to yourself too often, people might think you’ve lost your mind.”
hunks.sol: “Hm. That’s a bad habit. I don’t mind, but you should break it soon. If you talk to yourself too often, people might think you’ve lost your mind.”

hunks.baseline: My vision blurred, and when it cleared, a fierce-looking face was blocking my view.
hunks.sol: My vision blurred, and the next thing I knew, a fierce-looking face was blocking my way.

hunks.baseline: “Whoa! Take it easy, take it easy!”
hunks.sol: “Whoa! Calm down, calm down!”

hunks.baseline: “Let go! Let go! That ugly face of yours is already bad enough. Want me to make it even worse?”
hunks.sol: “Let go! You’re ugly enough already. Want me to make your face even worse?”

hunks.baseline: Ma Junggeol—the chief of the mounted bandits who’d somehow ended up following us this far, and now the head of a horse-caravan business—looked at me sadly.
hunks.sol: Ma Junggeol—the chief of the mounted bandits who’d somehow ended up following us this far, though he was in the horse-caravan business now—looked at me sadly.

hunks.baseline: “……That was a bit harsh.”
hunks.sol: “…That was a bit harsh.”

hunks.baseline: My apology eased some of the sadness from Ma Junggeol’s face.
hunks.sol: Some of the sadness left his face at my apology.

hunks.baseline: “Calm down. You know Great Sir didn’t mean anything by it.”
hunks.sol: “Calm down. You know Great Sir didn’t mean any harm.”

hunks.baseline: Maybe that was why his innocence made me even angrier.
He’d been a complete nuisance at a critical moment, and all that fuss had been over a satisfying bowel movement.
hunks.sol: Maybe his innocence was what made it even more infuriating. He’d drawn everyone’s attention at a critical moment, and all that fuss had been over a satisfying bowel movement.

hunks.baseline: *But I can’t exactly leave him behind somewhere.*
hunks.sol: *But I can’t exactly leave him behind.*

hunks.baseline: I sighed deeply and raised a hand for everyone to get moving.
hunks.sol: I heaved a sigh and raised a hand where everyone could see it, signaling them to move out.

hunks.baseline: Every moment mattered, and we’d already wasted nearly fifteen minutes for nothing. We needed to pick up the pace.
hunks.sol: Every moment mattered, and we’d already wasted nearly fifteen minutes for nothing. We needed to move faster.

hunks.baseline: *At this rate, it could take us several more days just to reach our destination.*
hunks.sol: *At this rate, it could take us several extra days to reach our destination.*

hunks.baseline: Each time, the Supreme Peak masters, including me, had led the charge and wiped out the pursuers. But the important thing was how quickly and relentlessly the enemy caught up to us.
hunks.sol: Each time, the Supreme Peak masters, including me, had led the charge and wiped out the pursuers. The problem was how quickly and relentlessly more of them caught up.

hunks.baseline: *They have eyes to keep watch on us—and monsters that can chase us without resting for even a moment.*
hunks.sol: *They have eyes to watch us—and monsters that can chase us without resting for a moment.*

hunks.baseline: They’d been reborn from death with their emotions stripped away. They hadn’t died, yet they were already as good as dead. They’d forgotten sensation, and for the same reason, they couldn’t even feel fatigue.
hunks.sol: Reborn from death, they’d lost their emotions. Though they weren’t dead, they were already as good as dead. They’d forgotten sensation, and for the same reason, they couldn’t feel fatigue.

hunks.baseline: *We haven’t been down from the mountains for long. But if they keep slowing us down like this…*
hunks.sol: *We haven’t been down from the mountains for long. If they keep slowing us down like this…*

hunks.baseline: Even if a hundred thousand undead came to close their hands around our throats, I had to lead everyone through this dense net and keep moving.
hunks.sol: Even if a hundred thousand undead closed in around us, I had to lead everyone through that dense net and keep moving.

hunks.baseline: As if she’d sensed what I was thinking, Ju Hwaran broke away from the people moving out and came over.
hunks.sol: As if she’d sensed what I was thinking, Ju Hwaran broke away from the others as we moved out and came over.

hunks.baseline: “If we can make it as far as Qinghai Lake, they won’t be able to pursue us so easily.”
hunks.sol: “If we can make it to Qinghai Lake in the east, they won’t be able to pursue us so easily.”

hunks.baseline: Song Ilseom, who—as always—stayed close beside Ju Hwaran like a shadow, spoke up unexpectedly.
hunks.sol: Song Ilseom, who stayed close beside Ju Hwaran like a shadow, spoke up.

hunks.baseline: “You’re not wrong. But that’s only if all of Qinghai’s forces have gathered there, and those monsters aren’t pursuing us with everything they have.”
hunks.sol: “You’re not wrong. But only if all of Qinghai’s forces have gathered there, and those monsters aren’t pursuing us with everything they have.”

hunks.baseline: “……Captain Song.”
hunks.sol: “…Captain Song.”

hunks.baseline: In a way, it was a discouraging thing to say, but Song Ilseom’s judgment was cold and accurate.
hunks.sol: It was a discouraging thing to say, but Song Ilseom’s judgment was clear-eyed and accurate.

hunks.baseline: You could keep hope in a corner of your heart, but your mind had to question everything.
hunks.sol: You could hold on to hope in a corner of your heart, but your head had to question everything.

hunks.baseline: Build for the worst, then strive for the best.
hunks.sol: Plan for the worst and strive for the best.

hunks.baseline: That was the most important thing when it came to survival and victory.
hunks.sol: That was the surest way to survive and win.

hunks.baseline: “If we push ourselves to the limit, two days. I’ve gone over the map in detail, and there’s no route that would get us there any faster.”
hunks.sol: “Two days if we push ourselves to the limit. I’ve gone over the map thoroughly, and there’s no route that would get us there any faster.”

hunks.baseline: She’d inherited it from her grandfather, who’d even been called the Escort King. It contained detailed notes on secret roads hidden throughout the land and the features of each region.
hunks.sol: She’d inherited it from her grandfather, the man known as the Escort King. It marked secret roads hidden throughout the land and described the features of each region in detail.

hunks.baseline: Especially in the northwest, with its endless open plains and basins, only sparse vegetation and reed beds grew. The terrain was full of obstacles for us.
hunks.sol: The northwest in particular was an expanse of open plains and basins, with little but scattered vegetation and reed beds. For us, it was about the worst terrain imaginable.

hunks.baseline: *But perfect for them.*
hunks.sol: *And for them, it’s perfect.*

hunks.baseline: If the pursuers kept catching up, that could mean three days, four days, or even more than a fortnight.
hunks.sol: If the pursuers kept catching up, it might take three days, four days, or even more than a fortnight.

hunks.baseline: I abruptly picked up the pace and tossed out the order.
hunks.sol: I abruptly picked up the pace as I gave the order.

hunks.baseline: Jeong Hogun, who was hunched low at the rear of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, reflexively asked, “What?”
hunks.sol: Jeong Hogun, moving hunched over at the rear of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, reflexively asked, “What?”

hunks.baseline: “……What did you say?”
hunks.sol: “…What did you say?”

hunks.baseline: “I said take it off right now.”
hunks.sol: “I said take it off. Now.”

hunks.baseline: At the sight of Jeong Hogun’s eyes practically shaking, I added an explanation to head off any misunderstanding.
hunks.sol: His eyes widened. I added an explanation before he could get the wrong idea.

hunks.baseline: I pointed at the armor, which had been thoroughly smeared with mud to hide its distinctive shine. Jeong Hogun frowned.
hunks.sol: I pointed at the armor, smeared with mud to hide its distinctive shine. Jeong Hogun frowned.

hunks.baseline: “I can’t. His Majesty personally bestowed this on every member of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t. His Majesty personally bestowed this armor on every member of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.”

hunks.baseline: “You don’t want to?”
hunks.sol: “So you refuse?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. No matter what orders the Marquis of Shangshan gives, this armor carries the authority and honor of the imperial family.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. Even an order from the Marquis of Shangshan cannot change the fact that this armor bears the authority and honor of the imperial family.”

hunks.baseline: “So you’d rather die protecting that authority and honor?”
hunks.sol: “And you’re willing to die protecting that authority and honor?”

hunks.baseline: “Fine. Keep wearing it, then. When you fall behind, we can just leave you behind.”
hunks.sol: “Fine. Keep wearing it. When you fall behind, we’ll just leave you there.”

hunks.baseline: “On second thought, I believe His Majesty did tell us to put the Marquis of Shangshan’s orders first.”
hunks.sol: “On second thought, I believe His Majesty told us to give the Marquis of Shangshan’s orders the highest priority.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll take that as agreement. Don’t waste time—give the order to your men right now…”
hunks.sol: “I’ll take that as a yes. Don’t dawdle—order your men to take theirs off right now…”

hunks.baseline: Then I sighed and spoke to Jeong Hogun, who’d just taken off his helmet.
hunks.sol: Then I sighed and spoke to Jeong Hogun, who had just removed his helmet.

hunks.baseline: *Rumble.*
hunks.sol: *Rrrrrumble.*

hunks.baseline: A tremor unlike anything the previous pursuers had caused began to churn in the distance.
hunks.sol: A tremor unlike anything the previous pursuers had caused began to surge in the distance.
